description: This is a Perl script named checkpatch.pl, used for static code analysis, style checking, and consistency enforcement in a codebase, particularly in the context of OpenWrt. It processes diff/patch files, source files, or git commit histories to identify issues like coding style violations, licensing issues, or other maintainership concerns. The script includes command-line options parsing, file handling, diff parsing, comment handling, and various analysis routines.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: No explicit class definitions are present; routines encapsulate functional blocks, but the script is procedural in design using subroutines.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays usage information and help message.

methods.name: list_types
methods.description: Lists message types that are used in checkpatch style checks.

methods.name: top_of_openwrt_tree
methods.description: Checks if the current directory is the top of an OpenWrt source tree.

methods.name: parse_email
methods.description: Parses an email string into components: name, comment, address, comment.

methods.name: format_email
methods.description: Formats name and address into a proper email string.

methods.name: reformat_email
methods.description: Parses and reformats email strings for consistency.

methods.name: same_email_addresses
methods.description: Compares two email addresses for equality.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Locates an executable in the system PATH.

methods.name: which_conf
methods.description: Locates a configuration file in user directories.

methods.name: expand_tabs
methods.description: Converts tab characters to spaces based on tab size.

methods.name: sanitize_line
methods.description: Sanitizes a line by removing comments, handling string escapes, and normalizing.

methods.name: line_stats
methods.description: Calculates line length and indentation size.

methods.name: show_type
methods.description: Determines if a message type should be displayed based on inclusion/exclusion rules.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates a formatted report message with level, type, and message content.

methods.name: report_dump
methods.description: Returns the accumulated report messages for dumping.

methods.name: fixup_current_range
methods.description: Adjusts diff ranges after line modifications.

methods.name: fix_inserted_deleted_lines
methods.description: Recomputes line list after insertions/deletions.

methods.name: fix_insert_line
methods.description: Records an inserted line for later processing.

methods.name: fix_delete_line
methods.description: Records a deleted line for later processing.

methods.name: ERROR
methods.description: Logs an error message and marks the file as having errors.

methods.name: WARN
methods.description: Logs a warning message.

methods.name: CHK
methods.description: Logs a check message.
